turns.text: So Instagram has teen accounts, um, and they have default private settings and sleep mode.
turns.zh: 所以Instagram有青少年账户，嗯，而且他们有默认的隐私设置和睡眠模式。

turns.text: And meta says this will limit the contents teens can see as well.
turns.zh: 而且Meta说这也会限制青少年能看到的内容。

turns.text: So tech companies are trying to do things to reduce the amount of time that people are spending on phones, and also like the harmful material they can access.
turns.zh: 所以科技公司正在尝试做一些事情，来减少人们花在手机上的时间，还有他们能接触到的有害内容。

turns.text: But what can I do to try and get some of my life back for hours a day or more?
turns.zh: 但我能做什么来试着把每天好几个小时甚至更多的时间夺回来呢？

turns.text: I'm spending on on this thing.
turns.zh: 我花在在这东西上的时间。

turns.text: Like, what can I do to try and fix that dependence?
turns.zh: 比如，我能做什么来试着修复这种依赖？

turns.text: Well, you could do like the extreme option, which some teenagers are doing around the world, which is just to abandon your smartphone altogether and get a brick phone.
turns.zh: 嗯，你可以采取那种极端的做法，就是世界上一些青少年正在做的，就是干脆完全放弃你的智能手机，换一部砖头手机。

turns.text: Not even a digital detox like, not have a smartphone.
turns.zh: 甚至不是那种数字排毒，就是不用智能手机。
